request.context: SND-009 stage 1: three sonar-f voice candidates using approved Russian lines.
request.text: Я у сонара. Слушаю эфир. Сверяю отметки с картой. О новых отметках сообщу. Пилот, слышу тебя. Готов сверить маршрут с тобой.
request.voice_description: Adult female Russian speaker with native, accent-free Russian speech. A calm professional on a long expedition beneath the ice. Not an announcer or a film actor. Quiet, focused, slightly higher and softer timbre than a pilot. Not whispering. Clean dry voice, no radio effect, echo, static or music.
